create_EmbeddingPackedParams: create a quantized embedding packed params module with num_embeddings, embedding_dim, and optional dtype
build_Embedding_quantized: build a quantized Embedding module with num_embeddings, embedding_dim, and optional padding_idx for quantized index lookups
build_EmbeddingBag_quantized: build a quantized EmbeddingBag module with num_embeddings, embedding_dim, and optional mode for quantized bag operations
test_Embedding_forward: test the quantized Embedding module forward pass with integer tensor indices and verify output shape
test_EmbeddingBag_forward: test the quantized EmbeddingBag module forward pass with indices, offsets, and optional offsets2 tensors
